caption: The drawing features a large bird with a rounded body and a long, straight tail facing left, occupying the central area of the composition. The bird is predominantly dark blue with lighter blue highlights, and its eye is accentuated with white. The bird's beak is short and pointed, and its feet have distinct claws, one foot perching on a curved blue line. Surrounding the bird are several brushstroke-like shapes in various shades of blue; these include small, abstract leaf or feather forms and a solitary vertical dash on the left. In the lower right corner, there is a drawn outline of a ceramic jar or vase. On the jar is a simplified illustration of the bird, rendered similarly but on a more compact scale. Above the main bird, the background contains faint text in block letters, reading "N. CLARK & CO" and, underneath, a partially obscured "LYONS." The background of the drawing is beige with some areas of light wash, mostly around the upper part. At the bottom right, the name "GEO. LOUGHRIDGE" appears in small, block capitals. The drawing predominantly uses shades of blue, black, and light gray, with minimal yellowish tones along the top edge.
title: Jar
